name: avatar-onboarding-fragment
description: Capture a reference photo, generate a stylised expression set (neutral/joy/thinking/listening/speaking/mouth_open) from it through a reference-capable provider, and register the neutral frame into the personal profile.

context.purpose: Reusable avatar creation flow with bridge-selectable image generation and profile registration.
context.required_inputs: capture_output_path, avatar_output_dir, identity_path, profile_name, profile_language, interaction_style, bridge_preference, avatar_style, consent_provider, consent_granted_by
context.failure_modes: camera unavailable, host bridge hand-off (exit 100, rerun after the host saves the frames), missing per-run consent for a cloud or host-bridge provider, avatar generation failure, identity write failure
context.consent_note: Cloud and host-bridge providers receive the photo only with a per-run consent: pass --context {"consent_provider":"<provider id>","consent_granted_by":"<who>"}. Empty = local providers only.

params.message: 🏁 Avatar onboarding complete. Profile updated at {{identity_path}}.
